outbreaks.title: Ebola (Bundibugyo virus) — DRC / Uganda
outbreaks.desc: As of 18 August 2026, WHO/AFRO reports 5,021 confirmed cases and 2,378 deaths (data through 16 August), with 751 patients currently hospitalised in isolation across six provinces (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele). This is now the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record. Uganda's national outbreak was declared over on 28 July after 42 days without a new case. An IHR Emergency Committee met 18 August to reassess PHEIC status.
outbreaks.more: Cross-border spread risk continues into CAR, Republic of Congo and South Sudan, with mobile lab deployment at borders. Two imported cases occurred outside the region: a US citizen medically evacuated to Germany (May 2026) and a case reported by France's Ministry of Health (24 June 2026). CDC assesses risk to the US public as low; no domestic US cases confirmed. A scientific trial for candidate treatments has begun enrolling patients — no vaccine or specific treatment is approved for Bundibugyo virus.

outbreaks.title: Infant Formula Contaminated with Cereulide Toxin — Multi-country
outbreaks.desc: WHO international food safety event notification: infant formula and products containing arachidonic acid oil found contaminated with cereulide toxin (produced by Bacillus cereus), affecting multiple countries.

outbreaks.title: Andes Hantavirus — Cruise Ship (M/V Hondius), Multi-country
outbreaks.desc: Fifth and reportedly final DON on this cluster. Following notification 2 May of severe acute respiratory illness aboard, 13 cases confirmed/probable across passengers and crew (147 aboard), including 3 deaths (23% CFR). A probable case in Tristan da Cunha was later lab-confirmed after disembarkation.
outbreaks.more: CDC assessed overall US public risk as extremely low throughout; coordination extended to State Department travel guidance for affected Americans.

outbreaks.title: Marburg Virus Disease — Ethiopia (closed)
outbreaks.desc: Outbreak declared over after two incubation periods (42 days) with no new cases. Final tally: 19 cases (14 confirmed, 5 probable), 14 deaths. 857 contacts completed monitoring. An earlier DON on the same outbreak was issued 21 Nov 2025.

outbreaks.title: Mpox — Recombinant Clade Ib/IIb Virus, Global
outbreaks.desc: WHO DON flags a recombinant mpox virus carrying genomic elements of both clade Ib and clade IIb — a genetic-mixing signal of concern for surveillance systems tracking lineage-specific countermeasures.
